capture_scope: frozen seek samples and source/key/layout/count-lock handoff; ramp/field and expiry capture pending

path.description: Absolute destination path. Existing files are never replaced.

dimensions.description: Full output raster size, before any region extraction.

time.description: Exact output-relative time in the registered output's half-open duration.

document.description: None discovers the project. A document filter limits the work.

owner.description: Unescaped project path of the owning node/container.

time.description: Authored document time; the provider applies nested clocks.

FrameRegion.description: Pixel rectangle in the full output raster; it does not change camera framing.

Key.description:
Identity of a native graph parameter or a fixed provider-owned property.
Property names are contract keys, never user labels or JSON pointers.

Placement.description:
Placement of a source document below a root document. The ordered owner IDs
distinguish repeated uses of the same source. Names are never stored here.

ProjectGuard.description: Project-wide operations deliberately have no document-edit scope.

object.description: Feature-owned object, such as a Motion scene object.

occurrence.description: Ordered native instance IDs below the document's root instance.

Time.description: Normalized rational seconds. Denominators are positive; arithmetic never wraps.
